item.title: Unit 03
item.description:
Reflecting on Failure

I think this unit is more practical. Before this unit I don’t known that much about failures?. This unit very new to me also very different unit compared other units. This chapter answered many question of me. Like How people come to out from failure to success?, How much time failures take?, How to face the failures? and How small things can make big problems?. In class my case study was about research on the Ariane 5 Failure. In this very small mistake of scientist destroyed the million peoples hope about space. This was carrying satellites to the space, This was planed after success of the Ariane 4. This is biggest software bug in world. Using IRS of the Ariane 4 in the Ariane 5 flight case the failure of the Ariane 5.Years after learning from the mistake they made it success. You heard anyone in the world who succussed in life without failures?. Before starting anything new first make sure about the information is correct. The failure takes place in a new territory. The failure is made towards a desired and meaningful goal. Being curious and trying to understand why something failed leads to new discoveries and innovations. Hence, failure should not cause shame but curiosity. Being curious and trying to understand why something failed leads to new discoveries and innovations. Hence, failure should not cause shame but curiosity. Failure is just a step towards success. This means failing in a smart and meaningful way called Intelligence failure. Many scientist experienced failures but they worked on the failures make it possible to success. Also i studied many case studies in the class. I faced problem in understanding the failures in the case studies presentation but it was more effective to me.
